desc: The Midwest Industries Handguard for the Henry 38 Special, 357 Magnum, 44 Magnum, 45 Long Colt allows the user to upgrade their standard rifle to use modern sights or lasers. The handguard includes one five slot M-Lok rail section and a forward mounted sling swivel for the use of conventional hunting slings. The handguard is constructed from 6061 aluminum, hard coat anodized, and is lightweight for an enhanced feel.
